scope: Independent RGB comparison, not an accuracy acceptance gate or performance benchmark
source: Native lossless AV1 boundary fixtures, 17x13, 8/10/12-bit, 4:2:0/4:2:2/4:4:4, full/limited range
oracle: FFmpeg/libdav1d native sample oracle followed by FFmpeg/zimg explicit BT.709 matrix and unchanged sRGB transfer, center chroma and bilinear upsampling
oracle_adapter: Direct zscale refuses odd subsampled extents (code 1027). Edge-extend native planes to the subsampling multiple without changing original codes; compare only the original rectangle. Source AV1 and independent decoded codes remain retained.
comparison_units: Absolute normalized RGB difference after clipping independent float output into [0,1], versus zen RGB16 divided by 65535. No threshold has been accepted.

validation.reason: Independent zscale refused odd subsampled source dimensions; failed artifacts retained

interpretation: The integer route cannot preserve excursions observed outside nominal RGB range.
Differences remain after clipping; do not equate independent float conversion with native-depth quantization and U16 bit replication.
A public float route still needs a specified arithmetic/precision contract and independent acceptance tests.
